blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
When you load a truck, every box has a place. And every instruction needs a preposition. In, on, at, under, next to — five small words. They save hours of confusion at the loading bay.

The bags go in the truck. The clipboard is on the dashboard. The driver is at the gate. The spare keys are under the tyre. The office is next to the bay.

These five words are simple, but they are important. "In" means inside something. "On" means on a surface. "At" means a specific place. "Under" means below. "Next to" means beside. Use the right word, and nobody gets lost.

items.q: Where do the bags go?
items.why: "The bags go in the truck." In = dentro.

items.q: Where is the clipboard?
items.why: "The clipboard is on the dashboard." On = numa superfície.

items.q: Where are the spare keys?
items.why: "The spare keys are under the tyre." Under = embaixo.

items.q: The text says these five words "save hours of confusion". This suggests that…
options: the wrong preposition can cause mistakes
loading a truck is always easy
items.why: Inferência: se as palavras certas evitam confusão, a palavra errada gera erro.

items.q: The author would most likely AGREE that…
options: small words can be very useful at work
boxes do not need a place
small words are not useful at work
items.why: Inferência: o texto chama as preposições de "small words" mas diz que são importantes.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Harry explicando para o novato onde colocar cada coisa. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Good morning! Welcome to your first day. I am Harry. Today I show you where everything goes.

First, the truck. Put the heavy bags in the truck, near the front. The light bags go on top. Please, do not put bags on the floor. The floor must be clear.

Now, look at the shelf next to the door. The tools are on the shelf. The gloves are in the box under the shelf. Take a pair before you start.

The forklift is in the corner. Only trained people drive it, so not you today, okay? Just watch me.

The clipboard is on the dashboard, in the truck. Write your name at the top. The driver is at the gate. When you finish, give the clipboard to him. Any questions? Good. Let's start!
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: Where do the heavy bags go?
options: In the truck, near the front
items.why: "Put the heavy bags in the truck, near the front."

items.q: Where are the tools?
items.why: "The tools are on the shelf."

items.q: Where are the gloves?
options: In the box under the shelf
items.why: "The gloves are in the box under the shelf."

items.q: Harry says "not you today, okay?" about the forklift. This suggests that…
options: the trainee is not trained yet
the trainee can drive the forklift now
items.why: Inferência: só pessoas treinadas dirigem, e o novato ainda deve apenas observar.

items.q: Why does Harry say the floor must be clear?
options: Because the bags are too heavy
To keep the space safe and easy to walk
items.why: Inferência: sacos no chão atrapalham a passagem — deixar livre é por segurança.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "Please put the bag in the truck." A bag is…
items.why: Bag = saco.

items.q: "Only trained people can drive the forklift." A forklift is…
options: a machine that lifts and moves loads
items.why: Forklift = empilhadeira, a máquina que levanta cargas.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "The tools are on the ___."
items.why: Shelf = prateleira, onde ficam as ferramentas.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Do not leave the bags on the ___. Keep it clear."
items.why: Floor = chão / piso, que deve ficar livre.

items.q: "The forklift is in the corner." A corner is…
options: the place where two walls meet
items.why: Corner = canto, onde duas paredes se encontram.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que aparecem no armazém. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "Please load up the truck before nine." To load up means to…
items.why: Load up = carregar, colocar as coisas dentro.

items.q: "Watch out! The forklift is coming." Watch out means…
items.why: Watch out = cuidado, preste atenção.

items.q: "Can you pick up that box, please?" To pick up means to…
items.why: Pick up = pegar / levantar com as mãos.

items.q: "Please put away the tools after work." To put away means to…
items.why: Put away = guardar, colocar de volta no lugar.

items.q: "We start at eight, so please show up on time." To show up means to…
items.why: Show up = aparecer, chegar.
